description: Lifecycle catalog for every maintained Markdown document outside docs/archive.

policy.growth: Prefer updating an existing authoritative document. A new document requires a unique purpose, owner, entrypoint, update trigger, and archive condition.
policy.history: Completed plans, dated execution records, and run/artifact logs belong under docs/archive.
policy.authority: One maintained document owns each current fact or procedure; indexes route readers and do not duplicate the owned content.
